body.purpose: Form labels, tile descriptions, footer link text.

override.note: Deterministic roll produced 'pale-gray'; Mode C override applies because the brand's captured ground is #FFFFFF stark-white, which wins over the seed roll.

seed.notes: Deterministic hash roll (byte-indexed against QuickBooks|2026-08-14) produced category-incoherent picks (craft: Photogram, register: Tabloid) for a B2B fintech login page. Per divergence-toolkit.md's research-first default, decade/craft/register were instead reasoned directly from the brand's category (current fintech SaaS, trust-critical, multi-audience) rather than forced from the roll. Ground-family used the Mode C brand-faithful override regardless.

anti_toolbox_hits.justification: Inherited directly from the captured site's own existing header pattern under Mode A brand-faithful inheritance — not a stylistic reach or assistant default. The captured page already uses a sticky-feeling persistent top nav; carrying it forward is fidelity, not a toolbox hit by the assistant's own initiative.

brand_faithful_inversions.pattern: Pure white / pure black in palette
brand_faithful_inversions.note: Captured brand ground is literal #FFFFFF and primary text is literal #000000 — both retained verbatim despite being flagged in some detectors as 'no pure black/white' hard rules. Brand-faithful mode overrides that rule per the inherited captured surface.

dualCTAPattern.description: Header Login control + page-level sign-in card both target the same action. Resolved by subordinating the header control (ghost/text-only) when the sign-in card is present on the same page.

header.purpose: Persistent site navigation + region selector + auth entry point.

footer.purpose: Site-wide utility navigation plus legal/trust-signal transparency.
footer.constraint: Utility-navigation and trust-signal content render as two visually distinct zones (Design Principle 4) — not one undifferentiated link wall.

persistent-help.purpose: Floating chat launcher — signature interactive element, preserved per signature-preservation rules.

iaPriorities.evidence: pages/global-login.json#ctas contains both 'QuickBooks Online' and 'QuickBooks Online Accountant' as a radio choice above the fold, routing two distinct audiences (business owner vs. accountant) to the same sign-in action.
pages/global-login.json#headings contains three promo-tile headlines (Banks/Invoices/Expenses) each with a 'Learn more' CTA, positioned alongside — not competing with — the sign-in action.

do: Lead with automation/speed framing for capability descriptions ("automatically", "in seconds", "in an instant") — matches the captured register.
Reuse existing account-type and CTA labels verbatim ("QuickBooks Online", "QuickBooks Online Accountant", "Continue to sign in").
don't: Don't introduce editorial-register vocabulary ("atelier", "dispatch", "the journal") — this is a product/utility register, not editorial.
Don't rename the two account-type options or the primary CTA label.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width dark navy button used for the main sign-in action, now with an explicit focus-visible treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0D333F; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: "AvenirNext forINTUIT", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; width: 100%; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0a2732; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0FD46C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (subordinated header login)
components.description: Text-only header Login control, subordinated on pages where a primary sign-in card is already present (Improvements #2).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #0D333F; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; font-family: "AvenirNext forINTUIT", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0FD46C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Promo Tile (card)
components.description: Full-color brand card pairing an icon, bold headline, one sentence of copy, and a CTA — unchanged structure, now resolved to the web-refresh token generation.
components.html:
🏦

Track and manage bank transactions automatically

Connect your bank to QuickBooks to set up bank feeds so your bank transactions flow into QuickBooks automatically
components.css: .ds-promo-tile { background: #0D333F; color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 8px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-family: "AvenirNext forINTUIT", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-promo-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-promo-body { font-size: 0.95rem; opacity: 0.9; margin: 0; }

components.name: Floating Chat Launcher
components.description: Fixed bottom-right circular launcher — signature component, preserved unchanged from the captured site.
components.css: .ds-chat-launcher { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0FD46C; border: none; box-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.15) 0px 10px 40px 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.15) 0px 4px 4px 0px; font-size: 1.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chat-launcher:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D333F; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This is a brand-faithful modernization, not a rebrand. QuickBooks' green/navy/teal identity, its AvenirNext forINTUIT typeface, and its bounded-color-block visual language all carry forward unchanged — the redesign resolves what the captured site left unresolved: two competing token generations, a fragmented sign-in/promo relationship, thin alt-text coverage, and an undifferentiated footer.
keyCharacteristics: Same palette, same type, same bounded-color-block motif language as the captured site
One design idea ties the sign-in card to the promo carousel
Legacy and web-refresh CSS token generations resolved to one
Footer restructured into clearly separated utility-navigation and trust-signal zones
100% of informational icons and logos carry descriptive alt text

rules.name: The Bounded Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated brand color never spans the full page background — it appears only inside rounded-rect blocks.

rules.name: The One-Generation Rule
rules.body: Every component resolves to the --web-refresh-* token generation; no legacy token references.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: AvenirNext forINTUIT carries every text role; no second typeface is introduced.

rules.name: The Flat-Card Rule
rules.body: Primary content cards are distinguished by fill color and rounded corners, not shadow.

dos: Do keep the exact captured palette and typeface — this is a brand-faithful modernization, not a rebrand.
Do resolve every component to the --web-refresh-* token generation; treat legacy tokens as deprecated on this page.
Do label every informational icon and logo with descriptive alt text.
Do keep the sign-in action as the first, most prominent interactive element on the page.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface family or a color outside the captured palette.
Don't strip the page to a minimal centered-card auth shell.
Don't let the header's Login control visually compete with the page's own sign-in card.
Don't apply drop shadows to primary content cards.
